quests.desc: Get ready to pick stuff up and put it in places, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to go north. Then, ensure that the portal is open. And then, take a trip north. Following that, ensure that the gate in the studio is open. Then, try to take a trip north. And then, ensure that the passageway is open. Then, go east. Then, venture east. Then, pick up the sandwich from the floor of the canteen. And once you've done that, you win!

objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make an attempt to travel north. With that done, ensure that the portal is open. And then, head north. Next, ensure that the gate is open. Then, try to go to the north. And then, ensure that the passageway in the cubicle is open. And then, go east. Then, make an attempt to move east. And then, pick up the sandwich from the floor of the canteen. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
